nodes.label: AI Forge Project
nodes.rationale: Standalone web application for building AI agent workflows using LangGraph with visual graph editor, file-based persistence, and hybrid custom code support.

nodes.label: Backend API Layer (FastAPI Routers)
nodes.rationale: FastAPI routers for workflows, runs, and secrets. Located in backend/app/api/.

nodes.label: Backend Engine (LangGraph Builder/Runner)
nodes.rationale: Contains LangGraph builder, runner, tools, conditions, and validation logic. Located in backend/app/engine/.

nodes.label: Backend Sandbox (RestrictedPython)
nodes.rationale: RestrictedPython execution environment for custom_function nodes and tools. Compute-only: no import, no network, no filesystem.

nodes.label: Frontend Flow Components (React Flow)
nodes.rationale: React Flow canvas, ConfigPanel, RunPanel, and panels. Located in frontend/src/components/flow/.

nodes.label: Frontend Library (API Client, Types, Graph Transforms)
nodes.norm_label: frontend library (api client, types, graph transforms)
nodes.rationale: API client, TypeScript types mirroring schema/models.py, and graph transforms for backend-to-ReactFlow conversion. Located in frontend/src/lib/.

nodes.label: Schema Models (Pydantic)
nodes.rationale: All Pydantic models: WorkflowDoc, NodeConfig variants, ToolDefinition, ModelConfig, RunEvent. Located in schema/models.py at repo root.

nodes.label: Frontend HTML Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Vite SPA entry. Loads /src/main.tsx as module script into #root div.

nodes.label: Condition Expressions (json_path, regex)
nodes.rationale: json_path: comparison (<path> <op> <literal>) or truthiness. regex: re.search against state['output']. llm: NotImplementedError.

nodes.label: Input Mapping (Reserved vs Data)
nodes.rationale: Run input fields split: reserved keys (messages, output, error, data, _node_outputs) map directly to state channels; everything else collected under data.

nodes.label: Tool Schema and Execution
nodes.rationale: Tools defined at workflow level, attached to agents via tool_ids. Three implementation types: custom_function (sandbox), builtin (registered handler), http (URL templating + secrets).

nodes.label: Async Execution + WebSocket Streaming
nodes.rationale: POST /run returns 202 + run_id immediately. Graph runs in worker thread via asyncio.to_thread. Events stream over WS with seq-numbered replay-on-connect. In-memory store max 200 runs.

nodes.label: FastAPI (Backend Framework)
nodes.rationale: Python web framework providing REST API and WebSocket support. No DI framework; routers registered in app/main.py.

nodes.label: LangGraph (Workflow Engine)
nodes.rationale: Core orchestration framework. Workflows are compiled into LangGraph StateGraph instances. Supports interrupt() for human-in-loop, checkpointer for state persistence.

nodes.label: Agent Node Type
nodes.rationale: LLM agent with system prompt and tool-calling loop. Reads state['data'] as user message if no prior messages, calls LLM with tools up to max_iterations.

nodes.label: Conditional Node Type
nodes.rationale: Routes based on output. Supports json_path and regex conditions; llm not implemented. Fallback: preferred handle → default → first static edge → ConditionError.

nodes.label: Custom Function Node Type
nodes.rationale: User-written Python in RestrictedPython sandbox. Receives state and writes to result. Only declared output_fields copied to data.

nodes.label: Human-in-Loop Node Type
nodes.rationale: Pauses execution via LangGraph interrupt(). MemorySaver checkpointer preserves state. Frontend shows paused state with input form and resume button.

nodes.label: Transform Node Type
nodes.rationale: Data transformation with three modes: template (dot-path placeholders), mapping (field resolution), custom_function (runs referenced node's sandbox code).

nodes.label: Per-Agent Message Isolation
nodes.rationale: State uses messages_by_node: dict[str, list] keyed by node_id. Sequential agents do NOT inherit each other's messages — they share only state['data']. Enables multi-repo workflows.

nodes.label: React Flow (Graph Editor)
nodes.rationale: Visual graph editor library. Supports drag-and-drop nodes, bezier edges, pan/zoom, custom node rendering.

nodes.label: RestrictedPython (Sandboxing)
nodes.rationale: Sandboxing mechanism for custom_function nodes. Limits to safe builtins, no imports/network/filesystem. Container-based isolation planned for Phase 4.

nodes.label: Secrets Store
nodes.rationale: ~/.ai-forge/secrets.json (chmod 600) with env-var precedence. Resolved via get_secret(name). Available in sandbox and ${NAME} placeholders in http tool headers.

nodes.label: Sidebar / Master-Detail Editor
nodes.rationale: Persistent left rail lists workflows; main pane is editor. Debounced auto-save (~800ms) + unmount flush. key={id} ensures fresh state per workflow.

nodes.label: SQLite Checkpointing (Deferred)
nodes.rationale: Planned replacement for MemorySaver to enable crash recovery. Currently uses in-memory checkpointer.

nodes.label: Static Graph Validation
nodes.rationale: POST /api/workflows/{id}/validate checks: duplicate node ids, dangling edges, missing start/end, cycle detection, unreachable nodes, conditional branch-count mismatches, unknown model/tool references.

nodes.label: Tool Execution Boundary
nodes.rationale: custom_function tools run in RestrictedPython sandbox (compute-only). http and builtin tools run outside the sandbox. HTTP supports URL templating, env-var secrets in headers, per-request timeout.

nodes.label: Workflow Shared State (5 Channels)
nodes.rationale: Five channels: messages (chat history), output (last node's string), error (reserved), data (general-purpose bag), _node_outputs (per-node results). Data is the bus; output is a cursor; messages is sticky.

nodes.label: REST API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Full workflow CRUD + run + validate + secrets. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:3000. Run is async (202 + run_id) with WebSocket event streaming.

nodes.label: Workflow JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: One JSON file per workflow in ~/.ai-forge/workflows/. Contains id, name, nodes[], edges[], models[], tools[], state_schema. Schema version for migrations.
